entries.source: the constant's value: dlsym of this symbol out of /System/Library/Frameworks/HealthKit.framework/HealthKit on macOS 26A428, decoded through CFStringGetCString as UTF-8, recorded per constant in coordination/corpus/ledger/constant-values-HealthKit.tsv with that binary and that build on every row; the declaration and its availability are the SDK 26.2 header's own (HKMetadata.h); the release is measured with tools/symbol-first-release.lua over the held ladder, which is the release check's own question
